title: 机器学习与AI项目合集：Python实现
summary: 该GitHub仓库汇集了使用Python构建的机器学习和AI项目，涵盖深度学习、生成式AI、AI代理、LLM应用、NLP、计算机视觉及自动化工具，旨在解决实际业务问题。
summary_en: This GitHub repository showcases real-world machine learning and AI projects built with Python, covering deep learning, generative AI, AI agents, LLM apps, NLP, computer vision, and automation tools to solve business challenges.
